workflow_02_deterministic_deduplication.scope: Deterministic bibliographic deduplication only; ambiguous cases leave Workflow 02 for adjudication.
workflow_02_deterministic_deduplication.identity_rule: lens_id is authoritative record identity, not duplicate evidence.
workflow_02_deterministic_deduplication.doi_rule: DOI is supporting evidence only and must not independently determine duplication; conflicting DOI/title evidence is retained for review.

workflow_03_adjudication.scope: Adjudicate residual duplicate candidates and route unresolved cases to human review without overwriting model provenance.

outputs: one prompt file per pending case
review_interface.duplicate_notification_policy: Queue fingerprint is deterministic from the exact set of pending review_case_ids; unchanged queue state must not trigger duplicate notification.
review_interface.chatgpt_link_policy: Use https://chatgpt.com/ only; do not invent unsupported pre-filled prompt URLs.
